memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Vitamin D deficiency
  Status: Initiating loading dose cholecalciferol 60000 IU weekly for 8 weeks.
  Plan: Check serum 25‑OH‑D after 4 weeks, calcium, phosphate; advise sunlight exposure 15 min daily.
- Asthma
  Status: Controlled on budesonide‑formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD, montelukast 10 mg HS, salbutamol MDI SOS.
  Plan: Continue current regimen, ensure inhaler technique, review ACT score next visit.
- Benign positional vertigo
  Status: Experiencing brief positional dizziness, Dix‑Hallpike pending.
  Plan: Start betahistine 16 mg BD, meclizine 25 mg SOS for acute episodes; arrange Dix‑Hallpike test.
Weight 62 kg, waist circumference 78 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Vitamin D deficiency
  Status: Level rose to 18 ng/mL after 4 weeks loading; still insufficient.
  Plan: Switch to maintenance cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD, re‑check in 8 weeks.
- Asthma
  Status: No exacerbations, ACT score 22 (last visit).
  Plan: Continue budesonide‑formoterol BD, montelukast HS, salbutamol SOS; reinforce spacer use.
- Benign positional vertigo
  Status: Dix‑Hallpike positive for right posterior canal; symptoms improved with betahistine.
  Plan: Continue betahistine 16 mg BD, taper meclizine to SOS only; consider vestibular rehab if persists.
Weight 61.5 kg, waist 77 cm.

memories.text: Spirometry: FEV1 2.45 L (78% predicted), FVC 3.10 L (82% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.79. Post‑bronchodilator FEV1 increase 12% and 200 mL, indicating reversible airflow obstruction consistent with asthma.

memories.text:
- Vitamin D deficiency
  Status: Stable on maintenance; last level 32 ng/mL (Jul).
  Plan: Continue cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD, repeat in Jan 2026.
- Asthma
  Status: Mild increase in wheeze during recent cold; ACT 22.
  Plan: Reinforce budesonide‑formoterol BD, ensure spacer, give short course oral prednisolone 20 mg OD for 5 days if symptoms worsen.
- Benign positional vertigo
  Status: Occasional brief vertigo on turning head left; betahistine OD helping.
  Plan: Continue betahistine 16 mg OD, meclizine SOS only, consider Brandt‑Daroff exercises.
